title: Aureline M5 retirement closure ledger
description: Canonical per-domain retirement closure ledger for a managed / new-tenant-gated feature reaching Retired. Names the object class, its supported-line association, the support-note closure state, the archival route, the tombstone ref, and the migration outcome so support and public-proof surfaces close cleanly on retirement and new-tenant gating is never bypassed. Downstream support, partner/procurement, program-governance, and install/update surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a class's closure ledger by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
